headline: Pakistan's Bank Alfalah Fully Exits Afghanistan After 20 Years
summary: Bank Alfalah finalized the sale of its assets and operations in Afghanistan following regulatory approvals from the State Bank of Pakistan and Da Afghanistan Bank, completing its market exit.
why: Bank Alfalah is one of Pakistan's major commercial banking institutions; the exit marks reduced foreign banking presence in Afghanistan.

impacts.name: Bank Alfalah
impacts.why: Divesting Afghan assets eliminates regional cross-border political risk exposures.
